resources.string: Authenticated YpsoPump status viewer; therapy disabled
Status-only mode: profile not sent to pump
YpsoPump: basal profile is programmed on the pump
Bolus must be greater than zero
Pump is stopped — it will not deliver insulin. Start it on the pump (Menu ▸ Run), then try again.
Pump reservoir is empty — it cannot deliver insulin. Change the cartridge, then try again.
YpsoPump: bolus delivery could not be confirmed
Bolus of %1$.2f U could not be confirmed on the pump. It was recorded so IOB is not under-counted — check the pump history and remove it from Recent insulin if it was not delivered.
YpsoPump: UNCONFIRMED — recorded %1$.2f U, VERIFY on pump
Pump reservoir is EMPTY — no insulin is being delivered. Change the cartridge now.
Pump reservoir low: %1$.0f U left. Change the cartridge soon.
Status-only mode: temporary basal cancellation not sent
YpsoPump: temporary basal was not set
YpsoPump: temporary basal set to %1$d%% for %2$d minutes
Insulin delivery control is disabled in status-only mode.
Readings are from the last update and may have changed. Check the pump to confirm.
Enter or import the details for your pump and its current session key. AAPS stores them securely and checks that they match the nearby pump. Insulin delivery remains disabled.
New details being checked: %1$s · %2$s · key check %3$s
Saved but not yet verified. Keep this pump nearby and tap Save and verify status.
Checking that the nearby pump matches the saved details…
Verification cancelled. Check the current setup before trying again.
The pump could not be verified. Check the setup details and try again.
Key creation time and age: unknown
Pump session key (64 characters, 0–9 and A–F)
New session key (only if the pump key changed)
This file contains your pump’s secret key. Transfer it only by a private method, delete any temporary copy after setup, and keep the original secure. AAPS will not delete the file you selected.

Check these belong to your pump before applying:
Serial number: %1$s
Bluetooth address: %2$s
Key check code: %3$s
The selected session file is invalid.
Enter the serial number in the supported format for this pump.
Enter the pump Bluetooth address as six pairs of letters or numbers separated by colons (for example AA:BB:CC:11:22:33).
Paste a 64-character session key using only 0–9 and A–F. The key cannot be all zeros.
The pump session could not be installed. The prior protected state was retained.
Verification could not be started. The new setup was cancelled; check the pump connection and try again.
YpsoPump needs attention: %1$s. Open Pump connection setup.
Pump setup is not complete. Open Pump connection setup and enter or import this pump’s details.
Bluetooth access is unavailable. Turn on Bluetooth, allow the Bluetooth permission, and check the pump is paired.
The pump could not be reached. Keep it nearby and awake, check Bluetooth, then try again.
AAPS could not authenticate with the pump. Check the pump details in Pump connection setup, then try again.
The pump status could not be read. Keep the pump nearby and try again.
The saved pump key may no longer work. Open Pump connection setup and enter the pump’s current key.
Pump status check is incomplete. Try verification again.
The nearby pump does not match the saved details. Move away from other pumps and check the serial number and Bluetooth address.
Enter the pump’s current key before trying again. Saving the same key again will not help.
The pump could not be verified yet. Keep it nearby and awake, then try again.
